case: An obligation is admitted with no production mode named at all.
why: The payload conditional refuses `none` on an exhaustible class; this guard is what refuses SILENCE, on every class. With the demand gone the field is optional in practice again and `named explicitly on the obligation` names nothing, which is the state G-01 was in. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.obligation.production_mode_named` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
